description: This file contains Redux selectors for managing application bindings, feature flags, and configuration within the Mattermost Redux state, specifically related to apps and UI components like app bars and RHS (Right-Hand Sidebar).

methods.name: appsPluginIsEnabled
methods.description: Selector to check if the apps plugin is enabled in the global state.

methods.name: appsFeatureFlagEnabled
methods.description: Selector to determine if the 'FeatureFlagAppsEnabled' feature flag is set to 'true' in the config.

methods.name: appsEnabled
methods.description: Selector that combines feature flag and plugin enabled status to determine if apps are enabled.

methods.name: appBarEnabled
methods.description: Selector to check if the app bar is enabled based on configuration.

methods.name: makeAppBindingsSelector
methods.description: Factory function that creates a selector to retrieve app bindings for a specific location.

methods.name: getChannelHeaderAppBindings
methods.description: Selector to get app bindings for the channel header if the app bar is enabled.

methods.name: getAppBarAppBindings
methods.description: Selector to get app bindings for the app bar, including backwards compatibility bindings.

methods.name: makeRHSAppBindingSelector
methods.description: Factory function that creates a selector to retrieve RHS app bindings for a specific location.

methods.name: getAppCommandForm
methods.description: Selector to get the command form for a specific app location.

methods.name: getAppRHSCommandForm
methods.description: Selector to get the RHS command form for a specific app location.
